correctness.rationale: The quadratic-form expansion into pair-pattern Walsh characters is exact because each sign squared equals one. Their orthogonality gives the displayed sum of squared coefficients. Every nonempty pattern has its own disjoint set of upper-triangular entries, proving independence and the closed-form rank and kernel dimension. Groupwise Euclidean projections with doubled symmetric Frobenius weights give the exact distance identity and sharp constants. The explicit signed-cross PSD witnesses square to the identity. General analytical arguments, rather than the 247 finite rational assertions, establish all dimensions.

originality.rationale: For tensor-product Rademacher probes, the exact per-matrix Walsh variance, the full zero-variance kernel with its dimension, and the sharp Frobenius-distance formula were not implied by the located primary theorems. Bujanović-Kressner establish rank-one probe unbiasedness and concentration; Meyer-Avron prove exact Gaussian variance but only an inequality for Rademacher variance. Classical Hutchinson is an independent-coordinate model. No prior theorem found in the accessible primary sections supplies the complete sign-dependent cancellation classification. Equivalence through less-obvious tensor-chaos identities remains a scientific precedence risk.
residual_risks: The Walsh-character variance identity can be inferred by elementary Fourier expansion; equivalent prior identities in other tensor-chaos or partial-transpose notation may be unindexed.
Novelty comparison is literature-based rather than independently verified; searches cannot establish uniqueness.
General practical value depends on whether Kronecker quadratic-form evaluation is cheaper for the operator being estimated.

value.rationale: Structured Kronecker sign probes are an established method for implicit trace estimation; the exact per-operator variance and full invisible subspace are natural algorithmic invariants previously obscured by generic concentration bounds. The theorem gives a diagnostic for which entries cancel, quantifies exactly the distance controlling variance, and exhibits both strictly beneficial and strictly harmful PSD instances relative to full independent signs. This is a structural classification with practical benchmarking relevance, not a mere reparametrization or an arbitrary table.
